notes.title: Map Escape, Performance Update, More FPS
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
In this update, we have added more military vehicles to the Escape map. We have also improved the game's performance, so you will now get more FPS in higher graphics settings than before with the same graphics.  

Update log:
1. Performance
1.1 We have improved the game's performance. You will get more FPS. If you are wondering why the game looks a little pixelated in the distance, this is normal due to the optimization for better performance.
2. Escape Map
2.1 We have added more military vehicles to improve the atmosphere. 
2.2 Don't be alarmed, there are now a few loose bodies. Fun tip: you can push the hospital beds around. 
3. Enemies
3.1 The enemies have been visually refreshed with bulletproof vests. 

Rge wishes you a good game and good luck with the missions.

notes.title: Patch for Escape Map
notes.content:
We have made minor changes to the Escape Map.
1. Changes
1.1 Several trees have been relocated.
1.2 Lighting has been adjusted.
Have Fun

notes.title: Audio Update for Escape Map
notes.content:
The following changes and additions have been made in this minor update: 

1. Enemy audio:
1.1 Improved and more powerful shooting sounds from enemies.

2. Audio update on the Escape map:
2.1 New atmospheric background sounds. 
2.2 Improved sounds for trucks in and around the base.

3. New model at the start of Escape.
3.1 A new model has been added at the start; you can see it right at the beginning.

Check it out and have fun!

notes.title: Enemy and End Update on Night House
notes.content:
In this update, we have moved enemies to the end of the Desert map. We have also enhanced the ending with vehicles.
Enjoy!
A major update is in the works.

notes.title: Enemy Patch, Dying Sound
notes.content:
In this small update, enemies have been repositioned and, above all, placed more sensibly. In addition, random death sounds have been added when enemies or players die. Feel free to send us your requests or feedback on Instagram. Instagram: RGE
Have fun! Your RGE

notes.content: [p]In the new update:[/p][p][/p][p]1. improved menu interface:[/p][p]1.1 Mission screen with images and targets[/p][p]1.2 Music in the menus[/p][p]1.3 Credits have been added[/p][p]1.4 Buttons customized[/p][p][/p][p]2. sound:[/p][p]1.1 New shooting sound[/p][p]1.2 Reload sound added[/p][p]1.3 Added music to menu, mission failed and mission successful widget[/p][p][/p][p]3. maps:[/p][p]1.1 Added some more enemies to the base in Escape[/p][p]1.2 In Desert, new enemies were also placed at a few points in the building and the light was also adjusted due to graphics bugs[/p][p]1.3 In Middle East a few rooms with more enemies have been changed[/p][p]1.4 Noise has been removed from all maps and will be added again in a few months with the AUdio update[/p][p][/p][p]It doesn't sound like much, but it makes a huge difference.[/p][p]Have fun your ShootX Studio RGE[/p]

notes.title: Night House Patch
notes.content: After the update on July 20, the instructions were no longer displayed correctly in the new design. This has been fixed with this patch. Your RGE

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
We adjusted the balance between players and opponents. The player can now shit faster and the opponent has less life. But the opponent now does more damage. We are currently working on new maps and a new desert map.
Greetings RGE

notes.title: Patch for Reload Animation
notes.content: This small patch was released so quickly because it affects the game experience. Aiming was slowed down after the reload animation. Greetings from your RGE team

notes.title: Light Escape Map Update
notes.content: In the new update, the light of the Escape map has been completely revised. Play and see for yourself. There will only be one more rework for the map Escape after that middle east will be reworked. Have fun

notes.title: June Update
notes.content: [p]RGE has added a new enemy AI that is smarter. The AI can withstand more but does less damage. The AI can also flank you and see you from a distance. Another feature is that it turns its back on you. We have also added bullet impacts both on the enemies with blood and on other materials with bullet holes. But we have also improved the animation. The magic has been increased from 30 to 40 bullets.[/p][p]Summary:[/p][p]New AI that is smarter[/p][p]Bullets impacts [/p][p]40 Rounds in the Magazin[/p][p]Smoother Reload[/p]

notes.title: Animation, Reload animation with R
notes.content:
The animations have been improved in the new update. A reload animation has been added which can be activated by holding R. The reload animation is purely cosmetic at the moment. The walk animations have been improved.

2. Reload animation (purely cosmetic) Hold R

notes.title: New Level and Patches
notes.content:
The following things have been added to the new version of the game:
1. Better instructions in levels
2. New night level called Desert

Problems that have been kept:
1. Enemies are easier to hit
2. Blocking of enemies at doors has been fixed

notes.title: Full Auto Feature, Balance Patch, Audio Bugs fixed
notes.content: Fire mode was automatically added in the update. It is now the only fire mode. The health of the enemies has been increased from 20 to 30. And a bug with the connection of the character's steps.
